program: PocketDJ Android parity 2 (iOS 1.0.3-1.0.6 + pocket wheel + Remote) — Levi 2026-11-23

decisions.decision: Android ships the latest main (no release branch); the Play app is FREE (no paywall/IAP); request every permission needed to be full-featured with prominent-disclosure flows; minSdk 35.
Bring Android to parity with iOS 'as the platform allows' and submit a new release; the 2026-11-02 'ship without the pocket wheel for now' deferral is over — the wheel is in scope.

W1 wheel in History ▸ Pockets with Wheel|List (Wheel default); W2 100 = songs PLAYED THROUGH, hard stop, no 'keep going'; W3 automatic synced 12-colour palette; W4 motion may upload (sensor modes only; Play Data safety Fitness info); W5 artist ban = run only + decaying penalty; W6 cycling folds into Trip, collection mode labelled 'Home'; W7 a Mix-cell best match loads Mix Auto-DJ when >= 10 deck-loadable songs.

Play on a pocket is a DERIVED run, never a replay ('Play the original songs' is secondary); >= 60 % of every run prefix unplayed in 30 days; long-press/right-click the centre ▶ for 'Clear this pocket'.
FX Lock capsule sits in the Effects header (upper right), no new row and no status line.
Mix decks stay mp3-only (Mix Together and DJ inherit this: non-mp3 rows are 'not a complete local file').
Do not resign a paused owner: play after pause resumes whatever was last paused (DJ/Mix Mode owner hand-offs must respect it).

Sequencer extension seams first (P2-PB-2/-3): hook bus, TransitionCause, start/advance interceptors, advance-without-load, session extras, replaceUpcoming, external-driver APIs. Later feature packages put their logic in NEW files and touch SetlistSequencer.kt only additively. Rationale: 10+ features need the sequencer; without seams every one would rewrite the same 1,641-line file serially.

DJ transitions use the NP DSP's existing private two-deck MixGraph ('ping-pong decks' + the graph's equal-power crossfader) instead of iOS's sample-accurate outgoing->tail move; same audible behaviour, less code, and it reuses the Mix tab's proven graph.

SharePlay -> Google Nearby Connections (P2P_STAR, offline, no server) as the Remote transport; an optional long-poll broker on the jukebox server keeps a future iOS<->Android route open. The Remote wire stays byte-identical to iOS.

Siri/App Intents -> one ShellActions door + deep links (always work) + launcher shortcuts + Assistant MEDIA_PLAY_FROM_SEARCH + App Actions capabilities (declared, best-effort) + AppFunctions on API 36+ (runtime-gated).
CoreMotion retroactive query -> Activity Recognition Transition API recording a device-local 7-day timeline while opted in; the same pure MotionSettle runs over it.

Vinyl album run = one ExoPlayer item per side with sequencer-armed boundaries (ExoPlayer PlayerMessage) and metadata-only replaceMediaItem retitles; per-song ClippingConfiguration is kept only for lone songs.

Every synced/persisted document keeps iOS key names and shapes; Android decoders keep unknown keys (passthrough) wherever Android re-writes a document iOS also writes (playback-session, play-history, edits, pocket-palette, apple-music-library).
Release safety: UI that lands before its engine is hidden behind A/ParityFlags.kt constants flipped by the engine package, so a release can be cut after any wave (release_cuts).

Waves are computed by tools/build_roadmap.py (dependency order, priority, <= 8 per wave, owned files disjoint, hot files <= 2 touchers per wave); edit spec.py and rebuild rather than hand-moving packages.

packages.title: Sequencer extension seams I: hook bus, TransitionCause, queue generation, start/advance interceptors, advance-without-load, session extras
packages.goal: Give every parity-2 feature (Mix Mode, FX Lock, DJ, album runs, pocket runs, Remote) a stable, tested way to observe and extend the sequencer without each package rewriting SetlistSequencer.
notes: docs/architecture/android-parity2.md §2.1-§2.3 (the seam contract every later sequencer package uses)
acceptance: SequencerHooks: ordered listener list with onSessionStarted/onSessionEnded(reason)/onTrackStarted(TrackStart{item,index,gen,path,fresh})/onTransition(Transition{fromUid,toUid,cause,seq})/onUserTransport(kind)/onQueueChanged(generation)/onFirstAudio/onHeld/onResumedFromHold; listeners run on Main, exceptions isolated + logged

TransitionCause {USER, NATURAL_END, AUTO_SKIP, STALL_HOP, UNPLAYABLE, REMOTE} recorded on every current-row change (AdvanceCause.AUTO split into NATURAL_END vs AUTO_SKIP/STALL_HOP); transitionSeq + lastUserTransitionSeq; queueGeneration bumps on every queue mutation

StartInterceptor seam: before the default resolve/load in playCurrent, registered interceptors (priority order) may claim the start; a claim gets the same generation/start-window/history bookkeeping via sequencer.completeClaimedStart(...)

AdvanceInterceptor seam on natural end (album glide, DJ advance-at-fade-start) and sequencer.advanceWithoutLoad(cause) = index move + repeat counter + skip tracker + history + meter + hooks, no PlayerPort.load
